name: patrol_monk_loop
about: sp_tutorial_1's monk_upstairs_podium loops its five nodes backward and stands at the podium (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/programs.md § 'Patrol paths, walked (2026-09-12, story 10g)'). The map's logic_auto sends SetupPatrolType '999 1 FOLLOW_PATROL_PATH_WALK' (t0) then FollowPatrolPath 'pod_1 pod_2 pod_3 pod_4 pod_5' (t+0.1); its logic_auto fires before a map record's time zero, so the record re-sends both verbatim. The player is set down at 0.1 s at the pentagon's centroid (-18872 -8942), over 250 cm from every leg and every pod (the Society hub is out of the start's PVS, where retail's normal think law stretches to 16 s; the teleport wakes every NPC within 2048 units, 0x1028d820). The seat is part of the statement: until spec 0002 V11 the record seated the player at (-18760 -9482), 66.6 cm from pod_1 -- inside the two hulls' 73.7 cm (HUMAN_HULL 13 units + the player's 16) -- so the monk could not stand on its node, the blocked-step arm S1 0x102eefb0 named the player as the obstruction and the navigator failed 0xc every 1.2 s (packets-S11 item 1; measured with the failure tail's Verbose line: 31.35 units left, blocker the player). That red was the record's, not the nav bake's. Type 1 (table 0x1049df20: first index = last, step -1, next type 1) loops backward from pod_5: pod_5, pod_4, pod_3, pod_2, pod_1, then pod_5 again. pod_1's keys carry target_name 'upstairs podium' and ip_percent 100, so the interest roll 0x1029f650 always wins there: TASK_FACE_PATROL_INTEREST 0xb3 turns to the place (match_orientation 1) and TASK_DO_PATROL_INTEREST_ACTIVITY 0xb5 claims it through 0x102a9f40 and waits RandomFloat(10, 15) (the place's min_time/max_time), then its run arm releases it (0x102da600) and fires OnInterestingPlaceLeft; the other pods carry no record and both interest tasks complete at once. Points by map Y (cm): pod_5 -9307, pod_4 -8504, pod_3 -8424, pod_2 -8966, pod_1 -9510. V4b (N13, 2026-10-04): the body is commanded retail's velocity script (0x102630b0, rebuilt every move tick by MoveGroundExecute 0x10264680) at the kernel's GetIdealSpeed 0x10091740, and stops by the script's own deceleration and the step clamp 0x10264916; the measured toggle (J9) took input_clearpatrolpath's first `arrived` from 10.428 s to 6.600 s -- the arrival creep is gone. The speed2d probe guards the cruise mid-way along a straight leg, within 10 % of this body's own walk_0: the male bank (shared/male/npc_allsequences), 136.683 cm/s -> 123.0..150.4; measured 136.683 at 6.5 s.
notes: Measured at the new seat (V11, FollowerArrivalFloorCm at retail's 0.0625 units): the five legs take 2.8 / 6.5 / 4.0 / 4.6 / 5.2 s, the monk stands 13.0 s at pod_1 (RandomFloat(10, 15)), fires OnInterestingPlaceLeft and loops; the floor under the seat is the hall's (the teleport lands, the monk raises SEE_PLAYER at 0.833). taskdone of the podium activity cannot come before 10 s after it starts (min_time 10): pinned by the `never` opened `after` `podium` and closed `within` 9.9 s (the relative window, V4o; 9.9 rather than 10.0 leaves the last think's instant to the >= comparison). V6 epoch audit: explicit fresh_map before this guard isolates authored state and allows an actual same-boot predecessor. Original seed, all behavioural predicates/windows/probes and existing script times retained.
